senses.title: The group as a whole
senses.titleCN: 藻类总称（一大类行光合作用的水生生物）
senses.definition: the whole assemblage of photosynthetic organisms that lack true roots, stems and leaves, from single cells to giant kelps
senses.definitionCN: 一大类没有真正的根、茎、叶而行光合作用的生物总体，从单细胞到巨型海带都包括在内
senses.example: At low tide the rocks are covered with a slippery brown-green film of algae, and longer ribbons sway in the shallows.
senses.exampleCN: 退潮时岩石上覆着一层滑腻的褐绿色藻膜，较长的带状藻体在浅水中摆动。
senses.why: the Latin plural is used collectively for the group, exactly as a class name is used in botany.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁复数被用作整类的集合名称，正如植物学中使用类群名那样。

senses.title: Single-celled algae
senses.definition: one-celled forms such as diatoms and green flagellates, often cultured or counted cell by cell
senses.definitionCN: 硅藻、绿色鞭毛藻这类单细胞形态，常被培养或逐个细胞计数
senses.example: Single-celled algae in the pond were small enough to pass through the filter.
senses.exampleCN: 池里的单细胞藻小到能穿过滤网。
senses.why: because the plural can be counted, it names individual cells when the context is a sample or a culture.
senses.whyCN: 复数可以计数，因此在样品或培养的语境中它就指一个个细胞。

senses.title: Seaweeds and large attached forms
senses.definition: large multicellular algae attached to rock or seabed, with holdfasts and fronds rather than roots and leaves
senses.definitionCN: 附着在岩石或海底的大型多细胞藻，以固着器与叶状体代替根和叶
senses.example: Brown algae along this coast form dense beds at the low-tide line.
senses.exampleCN: 这一带的褐藻在低潮线形成密集藻床。
senses.why: the same plural covers the seaweeds because they are algae by descent, only larger and attached.
senses.whyCN: 海藻在亲缘上仍是藻，只是更大且附着生长，因此同一个复数也涵盖它们。

senses.title: Freshwater algae
senses.definition: algae of lakes, rivers and ponds, including green filaments and cyanobacterial mats that float or coat surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 湖泊、河流与池塘中的藻，包括漂浮或覆盖表面的绿色丝状体与蓝细菌藻席
senses.example: Filamentous green algae choked the shallow end of the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 丝状绿藻塞满了湖的浅水端。
senses.why: habitat rather than form separates this use: the word stays the same, only the water changes.
senses.whyCN: 这一用法靠生境而非形态区分：词形不变，只是水换了。

senses.title: Bloom and red tide
senses.definition: a mass proliferation of algae that discolours water, depletes oxygen or releases toxins harmful to fish and people
senses.definitionCN: 藻类大规模增殖，使水变色、耗尽氧气或释放对鱼与人有害的毒素
senses.example: Toxic algae closed the shellfish beds for a month.
senses.exampleCN: 有毒藻类使贝类养殖区关闭了一个月。
senses.why: when the group multiplies out of control it becomes an event, and the class name is used for that event.
senses.whyCN: 当这一类群失控增殖，它就成了一个事件，类群名便被用来指该事件。

senses.title: Cultivation, feed and fuel
senses.titleCN: 藻类养殖、饲料与生物燃料
senses.definition: algae grown in ponds or closed reactors for oil, animal feed, fertiliser or wastewater treatment
senses.definitionCN: 在池塘或密闭反应器中培养的藻，用于制油、做饲料、作肥料或处理废水
senses.example: Algae grown in shallow ponds can be harvested for oil.
senses.exampleCN: 在浅池中培养的藻可收获用于制油。
senses.why: from the wild group the word passes to the industrial crop, because the same organisms are now farmed.
senses.whyCN: 从野生类群过渡到工业作物，因为被养殖的正是同一批生物。

senses.title: Symbiotic algae inside other organisms
senses.titleCN: 共生藻（地衣、珊瑚体内的藻）
senses.definition: algae living inside lichens, corals or sponges, giving them photosynthesis in exchange for shelter
senses.definitionCN: 生活在地衣、珊瑚或海绵体内的藻，以光合产物换取庇护
senses.example: Algae living in coral tissues supply most of the reef's energy.
senses.exampleCN: 生活在珊瑚组织里的藻提供礁体的大部分能量。
senses.why: the relationship, not the habitat, defines this use: the algae are inside another body.
senses.whyCN: 定义这一用法的是共生关系而非生境：藻在另一个生物体内。

senses.title: Fossil algae and ancient environments
senses.definition: algal remains such as stromatolites, diatomite and calcareous nannofossils used to date rocks and reconstruct past water
senses.definitionCN: 叠层石、硅藻土与钙质超微化石这类藻类遗存，用于测定岩层年代与重建古水体
senses.example: Fossil algae in the core showed that the lake had once been saline.
senses.exampleCN: 岩芯中的化石藻表明这个湖曾经是咸水。
senses.why: hard parts and mats preserve well, so the group name also covers its fossil record and the evidence it provides.
senses.whyCN: 坚硬部分与藻席易于保存，因此类群名也涵盖其化石记录与所提供的证据。

intro.en: Algae is the Latin plural of alga 'seaweed, water plant', borrowed into English in the seventeenth century and used collectively ever since. The deeper origin of Latin alga is uncertain: no Indo-European source is agreed, and comparisons with other words for seaweed are hypotheses.
intro.cn: algae 是拉丁语 alga「海藻、水草」的复数，17 世纪借入英语，此后一直作集合名词使用。拉丁 alga 的更深来源不确定：没有公认的印欧语语源，与其它语言中「海藻」词的比较均属假说。

items.en: Latin alga is recorded for seaweed and water plants in classical texts. Its deeper origin is uncertain, and proposals linking it to other European words for seaweed are unproven.
items.cn: 拉丁语 alga 在古典文本中已用于指海藻与水草。其更深来源不确定，把它与其它欧洲语言中「海藻」词相联系的提议未获证实。

items.en: Alga belongs to the first declension, so its nominative plural is algae; English took the plural form first and kept the Latin ending.
items.cn: alga 属第一变格法，其主格复数为 algae；英语先借入复数形式，并保留了这个拉丁语词尾。

items.en: Algae enters English in the seventeenth century as a learned Latin plural, at first in botanical and medical writing.
items.cn: algae 于 17 世纪作为学术性的拉丁复数进入英语，最早见于植物学与医学写作。

items.en: In the nineteenth century algae became the name of a major group in botany, contrasted with fungi, and the singular alga was revived for a single organism.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪，algae 成为植物学中一个主要类群的名称，与真菌相对；单数 alga 也被重新启用，指单个藻体。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word spread from taxonomy to water management, aquaculture and fuel research, where it is often treated as a mass noun.
items.cn: 20 世纪，这个词从分类学扩散到水质管理、水产养殖与燃料研究，在这些领域常被当作不可数名词使用。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and exact first date): the pre-Latin source of alga is unknown, and the first English citation is only approximate; any Indo-European form proposed for alga is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与确切首见年代）：alga 在拉丁语之前的来源不明，最早的英语书证只能给约数；凡为 alga 提出的印欧语词形均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like algae or share its Latin stem, some genuinely related and one not; group two holds field terms whose scope is narrower or different.
note.cn: 第一组是与 algae 形近或共享拉丁词干的词，其中有真同源，也有纯属形近；第二组是范围更窄或所指不同的同领域术语。

entries.definition: The singular of algae, used for one individual thallus; the plural in -ae is the form English borrowed first.
entries.definitionCN: algae 的单数形式，指一个单独的藻体；英语最早借入的其实是 -ae 的复数形式。

entries.definition: An English adjective meaning 'of or relating to algae', formed from alga plus -al; it is neither a plural nor a species name.
entries.definitionCN: 英语形容词，意为「藻的、与藻有关的」，由 alga 加 -al 构成；它既不是复数，也不是物种名。

entries.definition: A salt of alginic acid extracted from brown algae and used as a thickener; it is a substance made from algae, not another name for them.
entries.definitionCN: 从褐藻中提取的褐藻酸盐，用作增稠剂；它是用藻做出的物质，而非藻的别称。

entries.definition: Cold or chilly, from Latin algere 'to be cold'; it resembles alga- in spelling but has no connection with algae.
entries.definitionCN: 意为寒冷的，来自拉丁 algere「发冷」；拼写与 alga- 相近，但与藻类毫无关系。

entries.definition: The everyday term for large marine algae seen on shores; it excludes most single-celled forms, which algae includes.
entries.definitionCN: 指海岸上见到的大型海生藻类的日常说法；它排除多数单细胞形态，而 algae 包含这些。

entries.definition: Microscopic algae, cultured or counted individually; it is a size-based part of the broader group.
entries.definitionCN: 微小的藻，可培养或逐个计数；它是更大类群中按体径划分的一部分。

entries.definition: Photosynthetic bacteria formerly classed as blue-green algae; under modern classification they are not true algae.
entries.definitionCN: 过去被归为蓝藻的光合细菌；按现代分类它们并非真正的藻类。

entries.definition: The drifting, photosynthetic members of the algae along with cyanobacteria; it selects by lifestyle, not by taxonomy.
entries.definitionCN: 藻类中漂移且行光合作用的成员，并包括蓝细菌；它按生活方式而非分类来选取。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real stems, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的词干、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Algae is a plural in -ae, so one organism is an alga and two are algae; the adjective is algal.
normal.cn: algae 是以 -ae 结尾的复数，因此一个藻体是 alga，两个才是 algae；形容词是 algal。

normal.en: Colour names organise the group: green, red and brown algae differ in pigments and storage products.
normal.cn: 颜色名把这一类群分成几支：绿藻、红藻与褐藻的色素与储藏物质不同。

normal.en: Blue-green algae is the old name for cyanobacteria, which are bacteria and not algae at all.
normal.cn: blue-green algae 是蓝细菌的旧名，而蓝细菌属于细菌，根本不是藻。

normal.en: Algal bloom is the standard technical phrase; algae bloom is the looser everyday variant.
normal.cn: algal bloom 是标准技术说法；algae bloom 是较松散的日常变体。

normal.en: Alginate from brown algae thickens ice cream, and algaculture now grows algae for fuel and feed.
normal.cn: 褐藻来的褐藻胶给冰淇淋增稠，藻类养殖则为燃料与饲料培养藻。

abstract.en: Picture a wet rock painted with a thin green skin that no one notices until it slips.
abstract.cn: 想象一块湿石头被涂上一层薄薄的绿皮，没人注意，直到踩上去打滑。

abstract.en: Picture a pond turning soup-green overnight while the fish gasp at the surface.
abstract.cn: 想象池塘一夜之间变成汤一样的绿色，鱼在水面喘气。

abstract.en: Picture a coral animal farming tiny green cells inside its own tissue.
abstract.cn: 想象一只珊瑚动物在自己的组织里种着微小的绿色细胞。

examples.en: Algae range from single cells to kelps tens of metres long.
examples.cn: 藻类从单细胞到数十米长的海带都有。

examples.en: The aquarium glass was thick with green algae within a month.
examples.cn: 一个月内水族箱玻璃上就长满了厚厚的绿藻。

examples.en: Researchers grow algae in open ponds to produce oil.
examples.cn: 研究者在露天池塘中培养藻类以生产油脂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「algae」读似「爱尔吉」——海藻爱在水里长、爱在石上滑；纯属谐音，非词源

root: 拉丁语 alga「海藻、水草」的复数 algae；alga 的更深来源不确定，无公认的印欧语语源，与其它语言中「海藻」词的比较均属假说。英语 17 世纪借入，单数 alga，复数按拉丁第一变格法 -a → -ae。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one image: a green film on a wet surface, repeated at every scale. The group is named first, then the single cell, then the seaweed, the freshwater form, the bloom, the crop, the symbiont and finally the fossil.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个意象展开：湿表面上的一层绿膜，在各个尺度上重复。先指整个类群，再指单细胞、大型海藻、淡水藻，然后是藻华、养殖作物、共生体，最后是化石。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a green film that lives where water stays.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层绿膜，长在水停留的地方。

branches.en: The green film of simple cells on stone or still water.
branches.cn: 石头或静水上简单细胞形成的绿膜。

branches.en: Large seaweeds in the ocean and fine algae in fresh water.
branches.cn: 海洋里的大型海藻与淡水中的细小藻类。

branches.en: A bloom: algae multiplying until they color the water.
branches.cn: 藻华：藻类大量繁殖使水变色。

branches.en: Algae living inside corals or lichens as partners.
branches.cn: 藻类与珊瑚、地衣共生的伙伴关系。

branches.en: Biofuel and food uses of farmed algae.
branches.cn: 养殖藻类用于生物燃料与食品。

intro.en: Algae is a Latin noun borrowed whole, so its family is built from the Latin stem alg- plus English suffixes and combining forms.
intro.cn: algae 是整体借入的拉丁名词，因此其词族由拉丁词干 alg- 加英语后缀与构词成分构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin alga 'seaweed, water plant' gives the English singular alga and the plural algae; the same stem appears in the adjective algal and in alginate, named from alginic acid. The pre-Latin origin of alga is unknown, so no further Latin relative is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 alga「海藻、水草」给出英语单数 alga 与复数 algae；同一词干还见于形容词 algal 与得名于褐藻酸的 alginate。alga 在拉丁语之前的来源不明，因此不再列出更远的拉丁同族词。

items.exampleCN: alga 是单数，指一个藻体。

items.example: Algae is the plural form that English borrowed.
items.exampleCN: algae 是英语借入的复数形式。

items.example: Algal mats cover the rock surface.
Algology began as a branch of botany.
items.exampleCN: 藻类学最初是植物学的一个分支。

items.example: An algologist identified the bloom species.
items.exampleCN: 一位藻类学家鉴定出了藻华的物种。

items.meaning: a salt of alginic acid from brown algae
items.meaningCN: 褐藻中提取的褐藻酸盐

items.exampleCN: 藻类养殖提供饲料与燃料。

items.example: Copper sulfate serves as an algicide in reservoirs.
items.exampleCN: 硫酸铜在水库里用作杀藻剂。

items.example: Microalgae are grown in closed reactors.
items.exampleCN: 微藻在密闭反应器中培养。

latinEntries.example: Latin alga names the plant cast up on the shore.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁 alga 指被冲上岸的水生植物。

latinEntries.example: The Latin plural algae passed into English unchanged.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁复数 algae 原样进入了英语。

definition_zh: 别名；化名；又名
definition_en: a false or alternative name used by someone, or the word meaning 'otherwise called'
core_image: 两本护照同一张脸：名字换了一个，人还是那个人
scene: 通缉令上写着他的真名，后面还跟着另一个名字。The spy checked into the hotel under an alias.
sceneCN: 这里 alias 是「化名、别名」（第 1 个义项：使用假名或另一个名字）；句意是间谍用化名登记入住酒店。

derivatives.zh: alias 加 -ed 构成（技术用语），义为「使用别名的；被重命名的」
同根派生词，源自同一拉丁词根 alius，义为「使疏远；使 alienated」
同根近亲词，源自拉丁「在别处」，义为「不在场证明；借口」

senses.title: A false or assumed name
senses.definition: a name someone uses to hide their real identity
senses.definitionCN: 为隐瞒真实身分而使用的名字
senses.example: The fugitive lived for years under an alias.
senses.exampleCN: 这名逃犯用化名生活了多年。
senses.why: Latin alias means 'at another time, otherwise': the name belongs to the same person at another time or in another role.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 alias 意为「在别的时候、换个说法」：这个名字属于同一个人的另一时刻或另一身分。

senses.title: An alternative name or label
senses.definition: another name by which a person or thing is also known, neutral in tone
senses.definitionCN: 人或事物另外的称呼，语气中性
senses.example: Markdown, alias 'md', is the format of these files.
senses.exampleCN: Markdown，又名 md，是这些文件的格式。
senses.why: When no deception is intended, the same 'otherwise called' sense simply names a second label.
senses.whyCN: 当不含欺瞒意图时，同样的「亦可称」之义只表示第二种称呼。

intro.en: A Latin adverb meaning 'otherwise, at another time', turned by legal Latin into a name marker.
intro.cn: 一个意为「否则、在别时」的拉丁副词，经法律拉丁语转变为标记别名的用词。

items.en: A reconstructed root *h₂el- expressed 'beyond, other', also seen in alien and else.
items.cn: 重构词根 *h₂el- 表示「在另一边、别的」，也见于 alien 与 else。

items.en: alias meant 'at another time, otherwise', an ordinary adverb of difference.
items.cn: 拉丁语 alias 意为「在别时、否则」，是表示差异的普通副词。

items.en: Scribes wrote 'John Smith alias John Brown' to link two names of one person.
items.cn: 文书用 John Smith alias John Brown 标明同一人的两个名字。

items.en: The marker entered English both as the adverb 'otherwise called' and as a noun for a false name.
items.cn: 16 世纪该词进入英语，既作「又名」的副词，也作「化名」的名词。

items.en: Today computing borrows it for alternative file or command names.
items.cn: 现代计算机术语借用它指文件或命令的别名。

note.en: The first group gathers the Latin 'other' family and a look-alike; the second gathers words for names.
note.cn: 第一组收拉丁语「别的」词族与一个形近词；第二组收表示「名字」的词。

entries.definition: elsewhere; a claim of being elsewhere, hence an excuse
entries.definitionCN: 不在场证明；借口

entries.definition: belonging to another; a foreigner
entries.definitionCN: 外国的；外星人

entries.definition: to make someone feel estranged
entries.definitionCN: 使疏远

entries.definition: in computing, one name pointing to the same stored item
entries.definitionCN: （计算机）别名现象；指向同一存储项

entries.definition: a made-up name, especially for writers
entries.definitionCN: 假名；笔名

entries.definition: an assumed name, originally for fighters
entries.definitionCN: 化名；原指战士所用假名

entries.definition: a name taken on deliberately, like an alias
entries.definitionCN: 假名；刻意采用的名字

entries.definition: a writer's alternative name
entries.definitionCN: 笔名

entries.definition: an informal, familiar name given in addition to the real one
entries.definitionCN: 绰号；昵称

normalIntro.en: Latin alias, 'otherwise': the same person, another name.
normalIntro.cn: 拉丁语 alias 意为「换个说法」：同一个人，另一个名字。

normal.en: under an alias is the fixed phrase for using one.
normal.cn: 使用化名的固定说法是 under an alias。

normal.en: Alien, alibi, alias all hold the Latin 'other'.
normal.cn: alien、alibi、alias 都藏着拉丁语的「别的」。

normal.en: Spies and criminals use aliases; writers use pseudonyms.
normal.cn: 间谍和罪犯用化名，作家用笔名。

normal.en: In terminals, alias sets a shortcut name for a command.
normal.cn: 在终端里，alias 为命令设置快捷名。

normal.en: Plural: one alias, two aliases.
normal.cn: 复数：一个 alias，两个 aliases。

abstract.en: Picture one face behind two different hotel registers.
abstract.cn: 想象同一张脸出现在两本不同的酒店登记簿上。

abstract.en: See a name being peeled off like a sticker, a new one pressed on.
abstract.cn: 想象名字像贴纸一样被揭下，再贴上一张新的。

abstract.en: Imagine a message that arrives signed with two names joined by 'alias'.
abstract.cn: 想象一封署名处写着两个名字、中间夹着 alias 的信。

examples.en: She wrote three novels under an alias.
examples.cn: 她用笔名写了三部小说。

examples.en: The card went by the alias 'the Duchess'.
examples.cn: 这名骗子化名「公爵夫人」行骗。

examples.en: Set an alias for that long command to save typing.
examples.cn: 给那条长命令设个别名，省得每次都打全。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱理啊死」——换了名字装不认识，你爱理不理，他却假装不认识你。

root: 拉丁语副词 alias「在别时、否则」来自 alius「别的」（词根可溯至重构形式 *h₂el-），法律文书用它连接同一人的两个名字，16 世纪进入英语；同族词有 alien、alibi、alienate。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses divide the 'otherwise' by intent: a name worn to hide, or simply a second name on record.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项按意图区分「亦可称」：一个是用来隐匿身分的名字，一个只是备案的第二称呼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one face, two names on two registers.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张脸，两本登记簿上两个名字。

branches.en: a fugitive signing a stranger's name
branches.cn: 逃犯签下一个陌生人的名字

branches.en: a spy's passport that lies about everything but the face
branches.cn: 除了脸以外通篇是假的间谍护照

branches.en: a file known to the system by a shorter label
branches.cn: 系统里用更短标签称呼的文件

branches.en: a city listed under an older spelling
branches.cn: 以旧拼写备案的城市名

branches.en: the same second name, with or without a secret behind it
branches.cn: 同一个别名，背后或有秘密，或无秘密

intro.en: A Latin root for 'other' wearing the adverb ending alias, plus its English offspring.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「别的」词根带上副词词尾 alias，加上它在英语中的后代。

latinIntro.en: alius and alias are recorded Latin forms.
latinIntro.cn: alius 与 alias 都是有记录的拉丁形态。

definition_zh: 外国的；陌生的；格格不入的；外国人；外星人
definition_en: belonging to another country, strange and unfamiliar, or a person from another country or planet
core_image: 一个人站在热闹的街口，四周的话他一句也听不懂
scene: 夜市里人声鼎沸，他站在摊子前，听不懂旁边的人在说什么。The customs officer asked whether he was an alien or a resident.
sceneCN: 这里 alien 是「外国人、外侨」（第 4 个义项：法律意义上不属本国的人）；句意为海关人员问他是外侨还是居民。图中可辨识物件：夜市摊子、行李箱、证件。

pos.zh: 形容词：外国的；陌生的；格格不入的
名词：外国人；外侨；外星人

derivatives.zh: 由本词加动词后缀构成，义为「使疏远；使格格不入」
由 alienate 加名词后缀构成，义为「疏离；异化」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「陌生感；异质性」

senses.title: Belonging to another country
senses.definition: belonging to or coming from a country that is not one's own
senses.definitionCN: 属于或来自非本国的国家
senses.example: The plant is an alien species that spread along the river.
senses.exampleCN: 这种植物是沿河扩散的外来物种。
senses.why: Latin alienus meant 'belonging to another', so the word marks anything that belongs to someone else's place.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 alienus 意为「属于他人的」，所以这个词标记的是归属于别人那处地方的东西。

senses.title: Strange and unwelcome
senses.definition: strange, unfamiliar, and therefore difficult to accept or fit into
senses.definitionCN: 陌生、不熟悉，因此难以接受或融入
senses.example: The rules felt alien to everything she had been taught.
senses.exampleCN: 这些规则与她所受的一切教导都格格不入。
senses.why: What belongs elsewhere can also feel wrong here, so the word shifted from ownership to emotional distance.
senses.whyCN: 属于别处的东西，在这里也可能让人觉得不对劲，于是这个词从「归属」转向了情感上的距离。

senses.title: A being from another planet
senses.definition: in science fiction, a creature from another planet
senses.definitionCN: 科幻作品里来自其他星球的生物
senses.example: The film shows an alien learning to speak through music.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片讲一个外星人通过音乐学会说话。
senses.why: Twentieth-century science fiction reused the legal word for a foreigner and moved the border from a country to a planet.
senses.whyCN: 二十世纪科幻沿用了这个法律词，把边界从国界搬到了星球之间。

senses.title: A foreign national, in law
senses.definition: in law, a person who is not a citizen of the country in which they are
senses.definitionCN: 法律上不属所在国公民的人
senses.example: The customs officer asked whether he was an alien or a resident.
senses.exampleCN: 海关人员问他是外侨还是居民。
senses.why: Legal writing needed a neutral term for non-citizens, and the old adjective supplied it; the usage is now often replaced by foreign national.
senses.whyCN: 法律文书需要一个中性词指非公民，这个古老形容词正好补位；如今这一用法多被 foreign national 取代。

intro.en: Alien goes back to a Latin word for 'belonging to another', and every sense still turns on that idea of elsewhere.
intro.cn: alien 可追到拉丁语中意为「属于他人」的词，所有义项都围绕「属于别处」这个念头。

items.en: Alius meant 'other', the root of alias, alter and alien alike.
items.cn: alius 意为「其他的」，alias、alter 与 alien 都出自这个词。

items.en: Alienus meant 'belonging to another, foreign', and could describe both persons and things.
items.cn: alienus 意为「属于他人的、外来的」，既可形容人也可形容物。

items.en: French carried the word into law and diplomacy, where it named a person outside the community.
items.cn: 法语把这个词带入法律与外交，用来指群体之外的人。

items.en: English uses alien from the fourteenth century for foreigners and for things that do not belong.
items.cn: 英语自十四世纪起用 alien 指外国人，也指不属于本地的事物。

items.en: Science fiction added the planetary sense in the twentieth century, and the legal sense has since softened.
items.cn: 科幻在二十世纪加入「外星」义，法律义此后逐渐软化。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same 'other' root; the near-meaning group gathers outsiders and unfamiliar things.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「其他」词根的词；近义组收外来者与陌生事物。

entries.definition: To make someone feel unwelcome or distant.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人感到不受欢迎或疏远。

entries.definition: The feeling of being cut off from a group or from oneself.
entries.definitionCN: 与群体或与自我割裂的感觉。

entries.definition: A false name used by a person.
entries.definitionCN: 一个人使用的化名。

entries.definition: Belonging to a country other than one's own.
entries.definitionCN: 属于本国之外的国家。

entries.definition: A person one does not know.
entries.definitionCN: 不认识的人。

entries.definition: Unfamiliar in a way that is interesting rather than threatening.
entries.definitionCN: 陌生但有趣，而非令人不安的。

normalIntro.en: Two real parts carry the word: Latin alius, 'other', and the adjective ending -enus.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实部件承载这个词：拉丁语 alius「其他的」与形容词词尾 -enus。

normal.en: Alien, alias and alter all begin with the same idea: the other one.
normal.cn: alien、alias、alter 都从同一个念头开始：另一个。

normal.en: Alien to means foreign to, and it is the phrase that carries the emotional sense.
normal.cn: alien to 意为「与……格格不入」，情绪义就藏在这个搭配里。

normal.en: The legal noun is neutral, the science-fiction noun is exciting: context does the work.
normal.cn: 法律名词是中性的，科幻名词是刺激的：意义由语境完成。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: A-li-en.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：A-li-en。

normal.en: Keep the i before the e: a-l-i-e-n.
normal.cn: 注意 i 在 e 前：a-l-i-e-n。

abstract.en: A word for 'belonging to another' can describe a plant, a law, a feeling and a planet, because otherness takes many forms.
abstract.cn: 一个「属于他人」的词既能形容植物、法律、感受，也能形容星球，因为「他者」有许多形态。

abstract.en: The same word that excludes can also fascinate, which is why alien and exotic sit so close together.
abstract.cn: 同一个用于排斥的词也能令人着迷，所以 alien 与 exotic 靠得那么近。

abstract.en: Calling someone an alien is always a statement about the border, not about the person.
abstract.cn: 把某人称作 alien，说的永远是边界，而不是那个人。

examples.en: The customs officer asked whether he was an alien or a resident.
examples.cn: 海关人员问他是外侨还是居民。

examples.en: The rules felt alien to everything she had been taught.
examples.cn: 这些规则与她所受的一切教导都格格不入。

examples.en: The film shows an alien learning to speak through music.
examples.cn: 这部影片讲一个外星人通过音乐学会说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱连」——爱连家乡都不认识他，他成了这里的外人。

root: 源自拉丁语 alienus「属于他人的、外来的」，其词根 alius 意为「其他的」。

sensesIntro.en: One idea of elsewhere runs through all four senses: another country, another culture, another planet, and the legal line drawn around a community.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项贯穿着同一个「别处」：别的国家、别的文化、别的星球，以及围绕共同体划下的那条法律界线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a traveller stands at a busy corner and understands not one word around him.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个旅人站在热闹的街口，周围的话一句也听不懂。

branches.en: a plant that spreads where it was never native
branches.cn: 在并非原生之地蔓延的植物

branches.en: a rule book written in a language of its own
branches.cn: 用另一套语言写成的规则手册

branches.en: a light crossing the sky too fast to be a plane
branches.cn: 快得不像飞机的天上光点

branches.en: a form with two boxes: citizen and other
branches.cn: 只有「公民」与「其他」两栏的表格

branches.en: one outside position, felt and also filed
branches.cn: 同一个「在外」的位置，既被感受，也被归档

intro.en: A Latin root for 'other', its adjective, and the English endings that build the family.
intro.cn: 一个意为「其他」的拉丁词根、它的形容词形式，以及构成词族的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: alius and alienus are recorded Latin; the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: alius 与 alienus 都是有文献记录的拉丁词，更早的印欧词根属重构。

items.meaning: the state of being cut off

definition_zh: 可转让的；可让渡的
definition_en: able to be transferred or given away, especially of property or rights
core_image: 一件可以递到别人手里的东西：合同一签，所有权搬家
scene: 律师确认这份地契没有任何限制条款。The statute declares that land is freely alienable.
sceneCN: 这里 alienable 是「可转让的」（第 1 个义项：所有权可以依法转移）；句意是法令宣告土地可自由转让。

derivatives.zh: 加否定前缀 in- 构成，义为「不可剥夺的；不可转让的」
同根动词，义为「转让（产权）；使疏远」
alienate 加 -ion，义为「（产权的）转让；疏离感」
同根基础词，义为「外来的；相异的」

senses.title: Capable of being transferred to another owner
senses.definition: of property, rights, or titles: legally able to be sold, given, or passed to someone else
senses.definitionCN: 指财产、权利或产权：法律上可以出售、赠与或传给他人
senses.example: Under the new code, all land became freely alienable.
senses.exampleCN: 依照新法典，一切土地均可自由转让。
senses.why: From Latin alienare, to make another's: what is alienable can be made another person's own.
senses.whyCN: 来自拉丁语 alienare「使之归他人所有」：可转让之物就是可以变成他人之物的东西。

senses.title: Capable of being separated from a holder
senses.definition: able to be taken away or detached from the person who holds it, applied by extension to rights or qualities
senses.definitionCN: 可以脱离持有者而被取走或剥离，引申用于权利或属性
senses.example: Philosophers asked whether dignity is an alienable possession.
senses.exampleCN: 哲学家追问：尊严是否属于可让渡的拥有物。
senses.why: If ownership can change hands, the thing can also slip away from its holder, so the word stretches to anything detachable.
senses.whyCN: 既然所有权可以易手，物也可以从持有者手中滑落，于是词义扩展到一切可剥离之物。

intro.en: Built in Latin from the root 'other': to alienate is to make a thing another's.
intro.cn: 在拉丁语中由「别的」这一词根构成：alienate 就是「使之成为他人的」。

items.en: A reconstructed root *h₂el- meant 'beyond, other', shared by alien and else.
items.cn: 重构词根 *h₂el- 意为「在另一边、别的」，alien 与 else 共有此根。

items.en: alienus meant belonging to another; alienare meant to transfer ownership.
items.cn: 拉丁语 alienus 意为「属于他人的」；alienare 意为转让所有权。

items.en: alienabilis described property whose ownership could lawfully pass on.
items.cn: 法律拉丁语 alienabilis 描述所有权可依法转移的财产。

items.en: English borrowed the legal adjective alienable in the 17th century.
items.cn: 17 世纪英语借入这个法律形容词 alienable。

items.en: Its negative inalienable is far more common, famous from rights declarations.
items.cn: 其否定式 inalienable 远更常见，因权利宣言而闻名。

note.en: The first group gathers the 'other' family; the second gathers words for transferable and untouchable.
note.cn: 第一组收「别的」词族；第二组收「可转让」与「不可剥夺」两端的词。

entries.definition: impossible to take away or transfer, as of basic rights
entries.definitionCN: 不可剥夺的；不可转让的

entries.definition: to transfer ownership, or to make someone feel estranged
entries.definitionCN: 转让产权；使疏远

entries.definition: the transfer of property, or a feeling of estrangement
entries.definitionCN: （产权）转让；疏离感

entries.definition: relating to nourishment; only looks similar, different root
entries.definitionCN: 营养的；仅拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: able to be moved or passed to another holder
entries.definitionCN: 可转移的；可过户的

entries.definition: able to be legally transferred, as of property
entries.definitionCN: （法律）可让与的

entries.definition: able to be legally assigned to another party
entries.definitionCN: 可转让的；可指定的

entries.definition: available to be used or disposed of as one wishes
entries.definitionCN: 可自由支配的；可处置的

entries.definition: rights that no sale or force can strip away
entries.definitionCN: （权利）不可剥夺的

normalIntro.en: The word is alien plus -able: able to be made someone else's.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 alien 加 -able：能够变成别人的。

normal.en: alienare meant to make a thing another's.
normal.cn: alienare 意为使一物归他人所有。

normal.en: Most law talk pairs it with freely alienable property.
normal.cn: 法律语境里常与 freely alienable property 连用。

normal.en: Its opposite, inalienable, is the famous one: inalienable rights.
normal.cn: 它的反义词更有名：inalienable rights 不可剥夺的权利。

normal.en: Alienate has two faces: transfer property, or estrange a friend.
normal.cn: alienate 有两面：转让产权，或疏远朋友。

normal.en: -able marks possibility, like readable and movable.
normal.cn: -able 表可能性，如 readable、movable。

abstract.en: Picture a deed changing hands across a notary's desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一纸契约在公证人桌上换手。

abstract.en: See a ribbon untied from one parcel and tied onto another.
abstract.cn: 想象丝带从一只包裹解下，系上另一只。

abstract.en: Imagine trying to hand over your shadow and finding it will not come.
abstract.cn: 想象想把影子交出去，却发现它无法离身。

examples.en: Feudal tenure kept most land inalienable for centuries.
examples.cn: 封建保有权使大多数土地数百年来不可转让。

examples.en: The court ruled the lease was freely alienable.
examples.cn: 法院裁定该租约可自由转让。

examples.en: He questioned whether honour is alienable at all.
examples.cn: 他质疑名誉究竟是否可让渡。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱恋能宝」——爱恋着的东西也能转让，宝贝只要签了字就归别人。

root: 拉丁语 alienare「使归他人所有」派生法律用语 alienabilis「可转让的」，17 世纪进入英语；词根为 alius「别的」（重构词根 *h₂el-），同族词有 alien、alienate、inalienable。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses follow one handshake: ownership that can legally pass on, and anything that can slip from its holder.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项沿同一次「交手」展开：一是可依法过户的所有权，二是一切可能脱离持有者之物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a deed passing from one hand to another across a notary's desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：一纸契约在公证人桌上从一只手交到另一只手。

branches.en: land sold freely under a new legal code
branches.cn: 在新法典下自由买卖的土地

branches.en: shares changing hands on a market floor
branches.cn: 交易大厅里换手的股份

branches.en: a right argued to be beyond any sale
branches.cn: 被论证为不可买卖的权利

branches.en: dignity asked whether it can be signed away
branches.cn: 被追问能否签字让渡的尊严

branches.en: one question: can it pass to another hand?
branches.cn: 同一个问题：它能否换到另一只手里？

intro.en: A Latin root for 'other' plus the ending -able, with its famous negative beside it.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「别的」词根加词尾 -able，其著名的否定式与之并立。

latinIntro.en: alienus and alienabilis are recorded Latin forms.
latinIntro.cn: alienus 与 alienabilis 都是有记录的拉丁形态。

definition_zh: （从马车、自行车上）下来；降落；燃烧着；点亮
definition_en: to step down or land after a journey, or burning and lit up
core_image: 鸟落枝头与火苗蹿起：同一个词的两个去向
scene: 火车进站停稳，她拎着行李下了车。The passengers alighted from the carriage one by one.
sceneCN: 这里 alight 是「下来、下车」（第 1 个义项：从车上走下）；句意是乘客们一个接一个从车厢下来。

derivatives.zh: alight 加 -ing 转作名词，义为「下车；着陆」
同根基础词，义为「光；轻」，alight 由两个不同来源的 light 各构成一义

senses.title: To step down from a vehicle
senses.definition: to step out of or off a train, bus, or horse, a formal word
senses.definitionCN: 从火车、公共汽车或马上下来，正式用语
senses.example: She alighted from the train into the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 她下了火车，走进雨里。
senses.why: From the adjective 'light' in its old sense of getting off a horse: to go lightly to the ground.
senses.whyCN: 来自形容词 light 的古义「下马」：轻身落地。

senses.title: To land on something
senses.definition: to come down and settle on a place or object, as a bird or insect does
senses.definitionCN: 落下来停在某个地方或物体上，如鸟或昆虫
senses.example: A dragonfly alighted on the tip of the oar.
senses.exampleCN: 一只蜻蜓落在桨尖上。
senses.why: The same 'light landing' picture passes from riders to birds: whatever settles gently has alighted.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「轻落」画面从骑手转到鸟儿：凡轻轻停歇者皆可说 alight。

senses.title: Burning or glowing
senses.definition: on fire, or shining brightly with emotion or light
senses.definitionCN: 着火的；或因光亮、情绪而发亮
senses.example: The barn was set alight by a stray spark.
senses.exampleCN: 谷仓被一粒飞散的火星点燃。
senses.why: Here the base is the other light, fire and brightness: a- plus light gives 'in a state of flame or glow'.
senses.whyCN: 这里的词基是另一个 light（火光）：a- 加 light 表示「处于燃烧或发光的状态」。

intro.en: One form with two ancestors: a- plus light 'not heavy, dismount', and a- plus light 'fire, brightness'.
intro.cn: 一个词形，两个祖先：a- 加 light「不重的；下马」，以及 a- 加 light「火；光」。

items.en: *lingwh- is the reconstructed root behind light 'brightness'; *lingw- 'not heavy' shares the form by coincidence of sound.
items.cn: 重构词根 *lingwh- 是 light「光」的来源；表「不重」的 light 与之同形纯属音合。

items.en: leoht meant light and brightness; liht meant not heavy.
items.cn: 古英语 leoht 意为光、光亮；liht 意为不重的。

items.en: alighten meant to dismount, from the 'not heavy' light; alighten also meant to shine.
items.cn: 中古英语 alighten 既指下马（来自「轻」），也指发光（来自「光」）。

items.en: The verb narrowed to stepping down and landing; the adjective settled as 'burning, glowing'.
items.cn: 16 世纪动词义收窄为下车与降落；形容词义定型为「燃烧、发亮」。

items.en: The verb is now formal; the adjective survives in phrases like set alight.
items.cn: 现代英语中动词属正式用语；形容词存于 set alight 等短语。

note.en: The first group gathers both light roots and a sound-alike; the second gathers words for landing and burning.
note.cn: 第一组收两个 light 词源与音近词；第二组收「降落」与「燃烧」的近义词。

abstract.en: Imagine a match flaring in a dark barn.

examples.en: Never alight from a moving bus.

examples.en: Snow alighted softly on the bare hedge.

examples.en: The old theatre was set alight by accident.

definition_en: food and nourishment, or in law the duty of supporting a dependent
core_image: 从嘴到生命的输送管道：一口一口养活一个人
scene: 村里人轮流给病中的老铁匠送饭。The court ordered the eldest son to pay aliment to his mother.
sceneCN: 这里 aliment 是「赡养费、扶养」（第 2 个义项：法律上供养亲属的义务）；句意是法院判决长子向母亲支付赡养费。

senses.title: Food and nourishment
senses.definition: that which nourishes; food, or figuratively anything that sustains
senses.definitionCN: 提供滋养之物；食物，或比喻上维持生命的东西
senses.example: Bread and salt were the poor man's aliment.
senses.exampleCN: 面包和盐是穷人的口粮。
senses.why: Latin alimentum meant sustenance: whatever is fed in keeps a body or a mind alive.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 alimentum 意为「给养」：凡喂进去而维持生命者皆为 aliment。

senses.title: Legal support for a dependent
senses.definition: the legal obligation, or the money paid, to support a relative who cannot support themselves
senses.definitionCN: 供养无法自立的亲属的法律义务，或为此支付的钱款
senses.example: The decree fixed the amount of aliment at forty pounds a month.
senses.exampleCN: 判决将赡养费定为每月四十镑。
senses.why: If nourishment keeps a body alive, the law transfers the same duty to relatives: support is owed like food is owed.
senses.whyCN: 滋养维系生命，法律便把这同一义务转给亲属：扶养如食物一样是应尽之责。

senses.title: To nourish or sustain
senses.definition: to provide food or support to someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 向某人或某物提供食物或支持
senses.example: Hope alimented the settlers through the first winter.
senses.exampleCN: 希望支撑着移民们熬过第一个冬天。
senses.why: The noun passes into a verb: to give aliment is to aliment.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词：给予给养（aliment）这一动作即 aliment。

intro.en: From a Latin verb of feeding, carrying its sense of nourishment into law and biology.

items.en: A reconstructed root *al- meant to grow or nourish, also behind old, adult, and altitude.
items.cn: 重构词根 *al- 意为生长、滋养，也是 old、adult、altitude 的来源。

items.en: alere meant to feed and nourish; alimentum meant sustenance.
items.cn: 拉丁语 alere 意为喂养、滋养；alimentum 意为给养。

items.en: In legal Latin, alimentum named the duty to support a dependent relative.
items.cn: 中世纪法律拉丁语中，alimentum 指供养亲属的义务。

items.en: English took aliment in both senses, food and legal support, and later as a verb.
items.cn: 16 世纪英语兼收两义——食物与法律扶养，后又用作动词。

items.en: The noun is now rare outside Scottish law and scientific compounds; its descendants alimentary and alimony are common.
items.cn: 现代英语中该名词除苏格兰法与科学复合词外已少用；其后代 alimentary 与 alimony 更常见。

abstract.en: See a coin passed each month from one hand to an older one.
abstract.cn: 想象每月一枚硬币从一只手递向一双更苍老的手。

abstract.en: Imagine hope as thin soup that still keeps a man on his feet.

examples.en: The parish was bound to provide aliment for the orphans.

examples.en: Ideas are the aliment of a curious mind.

examples.en: She alimented the whole household on a weaver's wage.
examples.cn: 她靠织工的微薄工资养活全家。

senses.title: Relating to nourishment

senses.example: The clinic studied the alimentary needs of recovering patients.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所研究康复期病人的营养需求。
senses.why: The Latin base alimentum means sustenance, so the adjective first simply names everything to do with feeding.

senses.title: Relating to the food canal

senses.example: The bacteria colonize the lower alimentary tract.
senses.exampleCN: 这些细菌聚居于消化管的下段。
senses.why: Anatomy fixed the adjective to the one long tube of digestion, making alimentary canal its permanent home.
senses.whyCN: 解剖学把这个形容词固定在消化这条长管上，使其永久落户于 alimentary canal 一语。

items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 alcali 指同样的、用于制玻璃的煅烧灰烬。

items.en: Old French alcali passed the word on to English alchemists.
items.cn: 古法语 alcali 把该词传给英语的炼金术士。

items.en: English alkali first meant the ashes and their caustic salts.
items.cn: 14 世纪英语 alkali 最初指灰烬及其苛性盐类。

items.en: Modern chemistry redefined it as bases that neutralize acids; alkali metals, alkaline batteries follow.
items.cn: 现代化学将其定义为中和酸类的碱；碱金属、碱性电池等术语由此派生。

note.en: The first group gathers the Arabic al- family and a look-alike; the second gathers words for bases and salts.
note.cn: 第一组收阿拉伯语 al- 词族与一个形近词；第二组收「碱」与「盐」相关词。

entries.definition: of the nature of an alkali; containing alkali
entries.definitionCN: 碱性的；含碱的

entries.definition: a plant substance like an alkali, such as caffeine
entries.definitionCN: 生物碱（如咖啡因）

entries.definition: a distilled substance; shares only the Arabic article al-
entries.definitionCN: 酒精；仅共享阿拉伯语冠词 al-

entries.definition: to make or become alkaline
entries.definitionCN: 使碱化；碱化

entries.definition: the general chemical term for substances that neutralize acids
entries.definitionCN: 碱；化学上泛指中和酸的物质

entries.definition: a strongly burning alkali such as caustic soda
entries.definitionCN: 苛性物质（如烧碱）

entries.definition: a strong alkaline solution, especially of sodium hydroxide
entries.definitionCN: 碱液（尤指氢氧化钠溶液）

entries.definition: a salt of carbonic acid, often alkaline
entries.definitionCN: 碳酸盐，常呈碱性

entries.definition: the chemical opposite, turning litmus red
entries.definitionCN: 酸；化学对立物，使石蕊变红

normalIntro.en: al- is Arabic 'the'; the root is the burnt ash of a desert plant.
normalIntro.cn: al- 是阿拉伯语定冠词；词根指沙漠植物烧成的灰。

normal.en: Alkali turns litmus paper blue; acid turns it red.
normal.cn: 碱使石蕊变蓝，酸使石蕊变红。

normal.en: Al- words from Arabic: alkali, alcohol, algebra.
normal.cn: 来自阿拉伯语的 al- 词：alkali、alcohol、algebra。

normal.en: alkaline is the adjective; alkaline batteries use it.
normal.cn: alkaline 是形容词；碱性电池就用了它。

normal.en: alkali metals sit at the left edge of the periodic table.
normal.cn: 碱金属位于周期表最左缘。

normal.en: alkaloid = alkali-like plant substance, like caffeine.
normal.cn: alkaloid 意为「似碱的植物物质」，如咖啡因。

abstract.en: Picture grey ashes of burned saltwort heaped in a desert hut.
abstract.cn: 想象沙漠小屋里堆着烧过的滨藜灰。

abstract.en: See a strip of litmus paper turning deep blue in a beaker.
abstract.cn: 想象石蕊纸在烧杯里转为深蓝。

abstract.en: Imagine a white crust creeping across an irrigated field.
abstract.cn: 想象白色盐霜爬满灌溉过的田地。

examples.en: Soap is made by boiling fat with an alkali.
examples.cn: 肥皂是把油脂与碱同煮制成的。

examples.en: The lake water is too alkaline for most fish.
examples.cn: 湖水碱性太强，多数鱼类无法生存。

examples.en: Sodium is the classic alkali metal.
examples.cn: 钠是典型的碱金属。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱靠来」——酸碱相爱靠在一起就中和，碱总等酸来。

root: 阿拉伯语 al-qily「滨藜灰烬」（al- 为定冠词）经中世纪拉丁语 alcali、古法语 alcali 于 14 世纪进入英语，本指煅烧植物灰，现代化学定义为中和酸类的碱。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses spread from the same white powder: the chemical base itself, then the alkaline land it coats.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项由同一把白色粉末展开：先是作为化学碱本身，再是被它覆盖的碱性土地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: grey plant ashes in a bowl, blue litmus dipped in, fizzing handshake with acid.
core.cn: 核心意象：碗中灰色植物灰烬，石蕊纸浸入变蓝，与酸相遇滋滋中和。

branches.en: soap boiled from fat and ashes
branches.cn: 油脂与灰烬熬成的肥皂

branches.en: sodium flaring at the left edge of the periodic table
branches.cn: 周期表左缘上跃动的钠

branches.en: a whitened field losing its harvest
branches.cn: 泛白失收的田地

branches.en: a brackish lake no fish can live in
branches.cn: 鱼虾绝迹的咸碱湖

branches.en: one ash-born substance, in the beaker and on the land
branches.cn: 同一灰中之物，或在烧杯，或在田土

intro.en: An Arabic article welded to an ash root, with chemistry building its own descendants.
intro.cn: 阿拉伯语冠词焊接在「灰烬」词根上，化学又繁衍出各自的后代。

latinIntro.en: alcali is the medieval Latin form through which the word arrived.
latinIntro.cn: alcali 是该词传入时经由的中世纪拉丁形式。
